text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "One day in February. Ikuno Dictus was making Valentine's Day chocolates—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Just the right sweetness, with a smooth, melt-in-your-mouth texture...!
My friends are sure to love this.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The best friendship chocolates are complete.
A recipe guaranteed to bring a smile...
As specified, "IRON WILL."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Evaluation saved to database.
Standing by for next instruction."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Next...
please output a healthy chocolate recipe
with a strong focus on healthcare.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's for my Trainer. I'm going to pour all my gratitude
into making the best Valentine's chocolate ever!

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"The recorded inventory of ingredients is insufficient.
Please proceed to the store and make the necessary purchases."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This confectionery corner should have everything we need.
"IRON WILL," what shall we buy?

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Please purchase coconut oil,
100% cacao chocolate,
and cashew nuts."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The carbohydrates have been cut down considerably.
I see, it looks like this will turn out to be
the healthy chocolate I instructed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(However... it looks quite bitter.
Hmm—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: White chocolate cookies and caramel fondant au chocolat... Oho, are these Valentine's limited-edition items?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, if we showed that to Trainer-san, it would probably turn into quite a commotion.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there's something I'd like to talk to you about—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is it teatime already?
You've even prepared some delicious-looking chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, after you went through all the trouble to enjoy yourself,
I won't scold you, so please don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Just be careful not to overeat, alright?
It isn't good for your body, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you must enjoy sweets in moderation.
Your body is your greatest asset.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "IRON WILL, what potential health impacts can be expected from this recipe?"

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
" 'Expected benefits include lowered blood pressure,
improved memory, and overall constitutional improvement.' "

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Everything necessary for Trainer
has been properly gathered.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if they will be pleased with it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, after finishing my work,
I was relaxing in my room—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dooong)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry for dropping by so suddenly
on your day off."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"There was something I absolutely had to
hand over to you today."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's health-oriented chocolate
crafted using AI.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I made it much less sweet.
I hope it suits your taste...
choice_data_list: I see... Can I try eating some now?
I see... Can I try eating some now?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes... Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Emerging from the wrapper was a beautifully balanced
classic chocolate cake.
Taking a small bite right away...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?!
Are you all right?
choice_data_list: A-Ah! You just startled me a little, that's all!
Y-Yeah! I was just a little surprised, is all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It seems it was too bitter even for an adult.
I should have added a bit more sugar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was shockingly bitter, but her feelings came through loud and clear.
It must have tasted that way because she was truly worried about my health.
choice_data_list: Thank you for always being so considerate.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I want you to stay healthy in the future, Trainer.
Thinking that, I made this for you.
choice_data_list: I'll eat this and stay healthy!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Are you pushing yourself too hard
out of concern for me?
choice_data_list: I'll make sure to enjoy it properly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Deliciously", you say... I see.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... I'm glad you liked it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Would you like something
to cleanse your palate?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Please, take this.
choice_data_list: Huh, so you have other chocolates too...?
Huh, you have other chocolates too...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's not much, but... please open it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the package, a sweet aroma wafted out.
Inside were adorable chocolate truffles
adorned with colorful toppings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without hesitating, I took a bite right there.
Instantly, a melting sweetness spread throughout my mouth.
This is...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I used plenty of milk chocolate and fresh cream.
...How is it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: F-Fufu... Fufufu.
choice_data_list: Huh, did I say something weird?
Huh, did I say something strange?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm just so glad you liked it more than I expected.
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That was the face I wanted to see.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's strange, isn't it?
Normally, they're so particular about meals.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted them to say it was delicious today.
I simply wanted to see their happy faces.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: For Valentine's Day, being this sweet is just fine.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "...Whoops, look at me, talking so selfishly."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Thank you for the delicious chocolates!
Thank you for the delicious chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To think you would offer such kind words,
even though I merely acted selfishly out of my own preference.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you've got me there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I feel like I'm the one who's going to melt away.
